Title: Vegetation Index (NDVI) – Turin, 1–15 August 2026
Description:
Sentinel-2 NDVI median composite over Turin, 1–15 August 2026, 20 m resolution.
  Vegetation cools its surroundings through shade and evapotranspiration, so low NDVI areas tend to coincide with urban heat hotspots.
